subject.title: [Bug] memory-core dreaming: stable narrative session is archived by post-completion cleanup before host plugin can call getSessionMessages → narrative text lost

question: Should OpenClaw solve this by adding a generic post-completion session-retention/read contract, or accept trajectory recovery as the permanent memory-core-specific recovery mechanism?
rationale: Both paths can prevent the fallback, but they assign ownership, retention semantics, and future plugin behavior differently; current reports show the retry-only approach is insufficient.

options.title: Adopt a generic read-before-archive contract
options.body: Define a bounded subagent lifecycle seam that guarantees host retrieval after waitForRun, then use it from memory-core and keep cleanup explicit.

options.title: Keep the fix local to memory-core
options.body: Refresh the trajectory-recovery approach with strict session/run matching, retention bounds, and real multi-workspace proof, accepting the remaining plugin-specific artifact dependency.

recommendation.title: Adopt a generic read-before-archive contract
recommendation.body: Define a bounded subagent lifecycle seam that guarantees host retrieval after waitForRun, then use it from memory-core and keep cleanup explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers both the affected cleanup path and the relevant plugin-SDK seam.
